title: eSGA: _E. coli_ Synthetic Genetic Array analysis
protocol: Amplify the CmR cassette from plasmid pKD33 using forward and reverse primers.
Purify the amplified linear DNA using a Qiagen purification kit.
Design the linear DNA cassette to replace the target gene with the CmR marker.
Generate the cassette by PCR using homologous primers to the 3' end of the CmR cassette and sequences flanking the target gene.
Use the generated linear cassette as template for all subsequent PCRs.
Grow Hfr Cavalli strain carrying λ Red cassette in 50 ml LB medium with ampicillin at 32°C to an OD600 of ~0.4 to 0.6.
Mix two microliter of the amplified PCR product of CmR cassette with 50 μl of the competent cells.
Electroporate the mixture in an ice-cold 0.2 cm cuvette at 2.5KV with 25 μF and 200 ohms.
Add immediately 1 ml SOC medium to allow entry of the linear CmR cassette.
Incubate the cells at 32°C for at least 1 hr with shaking at 220 rpm.
Spread about 100 μl of the electroporated cell mixture onto an agar LB plate containing 12.5 μg/ml of chloramphenicol.
Incubate the spread plates at 32°C overnight.
Pick positive clones and confirm the recombinants.
Isolate genomic DNA from two random recombinant clones.
Amplify the DNA with two sets of knock out confirmation primers.
Run the amplified PCR products on a 1% agarose gel electrophoresis to confirm the correct product size of the amplicon.
Store two randomly selected recombinant clones for each query deletion mutant in cryovials containing 1.5 ml LB medium supplemented with 12.5 μg/ml chloramphenicol and 15% glycerol.
Grow frozen glycerol stock cultures of query deletion mutants overnight at 32°C in rich LB liquid media supplemented with 34 μg/ml chloramphenicol.
Pin the overnight culture of the query deletion mutant onto a LB plate supplemented with 34 μg/ml chloramphenicol using four 96-well long pins at a density of 384.
Thaw frozen glycerol stock cultures from an ordered array of recipient deletion mutants marked with KanR and pin them onto a LB plate supplemented with 50 μg/ml kanamycin at a density of 384.
Carry out conjugation by pinning the overnight query and recipient deletion mutant cultures at a 384 density using 384-well solid pins.
Subject conjugants to first round of selection onto a LB plate supplemented with chloramphenicol and kanamycin antibiotics.
Combine two 384 colony density conjugation plates in duplicate onto a double drug plate to create 1,536 colony density plates.
Pin colonies from the first double drug selection plate onto a second double drug selection plate.
Incubate plates for 24 hours at 32°C after each step of the selection process.
Photograph colonies from the second double drug plate using a Canon Powershot A640 digital camera.
Save captured images as jpeg files.
Quantitatively assay growth phenotype of the double mutants using an in-house automated image processing system.
